profile.tagline: Reliable and hardworking student committed to forstering pivotal experiences in supply chain management to fully observe and understand how supply chain decisions affects business processes and operations.
intro: Hi, I'm Jared Walters. I am a senior supply chain management major at Rutgers Business School. My career interests and experience for supply chain management include logsitics, demand planning, risk management, and resrouce planning. Ultimately, I would like to garner more supply chain experience in the pharmaceutical supply chain so that I may contribute to substantial changes to the development and devlivery of products that will change lives daily.

My interests focus on supply chain management, operations, finance, and data analytics. I enjoy leveraging data visualization and analytical tools to turn information into clear, actionable deliverables.
